**Calendar Bookings API Guide**

This API lets you build calendar and booking features into your application. Whether you're creating a scheduling app, managing reservations, or connecting multiple calendars, this API handles the core operations: creating events, checking availability, updating reservations, and managing time slots across users or resources.

The guide covers all endpoints you need to integrate bookings into your system. You'll learn how to create and retrieve events, manage availability windows, handle time zones, and prevent double-bookings. Each endpoint includes example requests and responses, along with common error cases and how to handle them.

We've organized this by workflow rather than alphabetical listing—start with "Getting Started" if you're new to the API, or jump to a specific section if you're integrating a particular feature. Code samples are available in Python, JavaScript, and cURL.

You'll need an API key to authenticate requests. Create one in your dashboard before you begin. Rate limits are generous for most use cases, but the section on pagination and bulk operations covers handling larger datasets efficiently.

By the end, you'll be able to build a complete booking system: let users view available times, make reservations, reschedule or cancel appointments, and send confirmations back to your app.

**Calendar Bookings API Guide**

This API manages calendar events, bookings, and availability. Add scheduling features to your app with endpoints for creating events, checking open slots, managing reservations, and preventing conflicts.

The guide covers every endpoint you need to build a complete booking system. Learn to create and retrieve events, define availability windows, handle time zones, and prevent double-bookings. Request and response examples appear in Python, JavaScript, and cURL. Each section includes common errors and solutions.

We organized this by task, not alphabetically. Start with "Getting Started" if you're new, or jump straight to what you need. Get an API key from your dashboard to authenticate requests.

Rate limits work for most applications. Refer to pagination guidance when handling large datasets. Separate sections cover time zones and daylight saving time edge cases.

This API powers:

- Displaying available time slots to users
- Creating, confirming, and updating reservations
- Letting users reschedule or cancel bookings
- Connecting with other calendar systems
- Managing events across time zones

Begin with "Getting Started" or go directly to the endpoint reference if you're familiar with REST APIs. A sandbox environment is available for testing.
